payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops over all laptops; mark as outdated (set cost 9999) if any other laptop has strictly better speed, ram, hdd. Then pick minimum cost.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a pairwise comparison (O(n^2) complete search) with an early break. While not recursive, it aligns with backtracking-like pruning among given complete_search subtypes.
